feeds.title: Center For Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: The Center for Family Medicine is devoted to providing compassionate, patient-centered care for the entire family in an educational setting. We are committed to improving the health of our patients, their families, and our communities. Through our blog posts, we create awareness and intend to inspire self-care.

feeds.title: Noreta Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: At Noreta Family Medicine, we want to simplify your healthcare experience and improve the quality of your life. We create a more personal experience for you at a lower cost than a traditional practice. Dr. Melissa Boylan shares some tips and tricks on how to stay healthy and talks about how my practice is different than most.

feeds.title: Hitchcock Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: At Hitchcock Family Medicine, we can return the medical decision-making power to the doctor and patient and out of the hands of the insurance companies. Learn more about family and pediatric medicine, integrated medicine, women's health, physical therapy, and more.

feeds.title: Homeopathic Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Homeopathic Family Medicine - Owned & directed by Dana Ullman, is North America's leading resource center for everything homeopathic including books, tapes, research, medicines, medicine kits, software for the general public and the health professional, and correspondence courses. Learn more about homeopathy and natural medicine in a modern and compelling fashion.

feeds.title: STFM Blog » Family Medicine Stories
feeds.description: Founded in 1967, the Society of Teachers of Family Medicine is a national community of academic leaders committed to developing an accomplished family medicine workforce, prepared to serve as the foundation of America's healthcare system. Read about family medicine stories written by healthcare professionals.

feeds.title: Imperial Center Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: At Imperial Center Family Medicine, we have been meeting the medical needs of families since 1999. Our experienced providers offer primary and preventative services to help manage ongoing health and wellness needs. Read Imperial Center Family Medicine's blogs for up-to-date information relating to all things about family medicine.

feeds.title: Center for Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Here at the Center for Family Medicine, advises you through all of life's health stages from childhood through geriatrics. We have been serving for nearly thirty years and continue to grow! Center for Family Medicine offers healthcare education on a weekly blog with topics covering most major medical conditions.

feeds.title: Houston Family Practice Blog
feeds.description: Houston Family Practice's goal is to make you feel better as quickly as possible. We are proud to provide a high-quality level of customer service, medical experience, and commitment to health and wellness to all our patients. Read all our latest blogs on a wide range of surgical and non-surgical services along with the latest developments made in the field of family healthcare.

feeds.title: Family Integrative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: At Family Integrative Medicine, our expert team of highly skilled physicians will help you regain your quality of life by increasing your body's natural ability to heal itself through Responsible Pain Management, a non-surgical, non-drug solution. RPM is your best option for lasting pain relief. Check out Family Integrative Medicine's blog and videos resource center, filled with educational info about integrative medicine, chronic pain, and more.

feeds.title: Joy in Family Medicine Coaching Services Blog
feeds.description: Tonya Caylor, MD, FAAFP, founded Joy in Family Medicine Coaching Services and her blog unpacks ways family medicine physicians, including those in training and their faculty, can thrive in their chosen careers and enjoy life. I give you tools to reduce unnecessary suffering & move you forward to the next level.

feeds.title: Evergreen Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: We have evolved into an innovative advanced patient-centered home where patients of any age and circumstance can be confident of compassionate care and proper guidance as they navigate our healthcare system. In our blog, one can find information about women's health, Covid, our newsletter, and more.

feeds.title: New South Family Medicine and MedSpa Blog
feeds.description: At New South Family Medicine and MedSpa, we share relevant and helpful information so we can better communicate with our audience. Reading a blog might help you find answers to some of the questions you have. Questions from hot flashes and hormone imbalances to laser treatments. Dr. Mendelsohn is excited to bring the first direct primary care and personalized MedSpa to you.

feeds.title: Medwin Family Medicine & Rehab Blog
feeds.description: Started in 2004, Medwin Family Medicine and Rehab provides quality medical care to patients of all ages. We also offer rehabilitation services for those who have suffered an injury or are recovering from surgery. Read about integrated medicine, IV therapy, and more.

feeds.title: Family Medicine Vital Signs
feeds.description: This is a blog hosted by the faculty and residents of the University of Utah Family Medicine Residency. We hope to start a broader discussion of Family Medicine and its role in the changing healthcare environment, as well as best practices on how to educate students and residents to practice in the 21st Century.

feeds.title: MAFP
feeds.description: MAFP is a state chapter of AAFP, federal advocacy team shares an update about improving access to primary care, the call for further legislative action on the youth mental health crisis, the latest data on the role of family physicians in maternity care deserts, and more. We offer continuing medical education opportunities throughout the year, support advocacy of family medicine, and promote the specialty of family medicine to medical students.

feeds.title: Osteopathic Center for Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Osteopathic Center for Family Medicine's goal is to form a partnership with patients and help them make informed decisions about their care. We explore the risks and benefits of all treatment options so that patients feel knowledgeable and comfortable about their decisions. Know more about us through our blog.

feeds.title: Family Medicine Austin Blog
feeds.description: Family Medicine Austin provides Comprehensive Preventive, Diagnostic, and Chronic Disease Management for individuals and families. With an expert medical team led by board-certified family medicine physician, Dr. Lamia Kadir, the practice offers compassionate, quality healthcare for all patients.Learn about STDs, UTIs, hormones, and more.

feeds.title: Georgetown Pediatrics & Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: The mission at Georgetown Pediatrics & Family Medicine is to provide patients with the best, most comprehensive care for all ages from birth to seniors. We are recognized for our compassion, knowledge, and unyielding commitment to excellence. Read about the latest news, developments, research, and history.

feeds.title: Vida Family Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Vida Family Medicine is an innovative family medicine practice offering direct primary care for all ages as well as in-home 4th-trimester care and lactation support, owned and run by Dr. Rebecca Berens. Stay up to date with events and happenings at the practice, as well as health issues locally and nationally.

feeds.title: CentraCare Blog » Family Medicine
feeds.description: Since 1995, CentraCare works to improve well-being by providing the latest advancements in care, technology & treatments close to home. Our goal is to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone is treated with fairness, dignity, and respect. Be sure to check out our blog regularly for new posts about our hospitals and clinics, the latest healthcare news, and general health and wellness information.

feeds.title: American Family Physician Community Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the AFP Community Blog, written and moderated by the editors of American Family Physician, a peer-reviewed medical journal. The AFP Community Blog is a public forum for anyone interested in exchanging views on topics related to the journal and family medicine.

feeds.title: Family Medicine & Wellness Blog
feeds.description: At Family Medicine and Wellness, we believe that health and wellness is of utmost importance for well-being and are attained through a personalized patient-physician relationship. Check out our blog to know more about the family doctor, chronic care management, annual physical exams, and more.
